title: TREAT 2N1 NWN – 20-21/06/2026
summary: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the TYHA TYH SEAZ JEZ VARIAM in the holiday program, Team Building and Gala Dinner at the Chinese Sea City.

content.text: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the TYHA TYH SEAZ JEZ VARIAM in the holiday program, Team Building and Gala Dinner at the Chinese Sea City.

Two days a night is a time for the staff to relax together, repower, strengthen the spirit of unity and create memorable moments on the co-workers. The dynamic Team Building Night of the Home Gala Dinner has contributed to the collective bond, spreading the team spirit and building sustainable business culture.
Sincerely, thank the Leaders and All Staff of the NHH NHH NHH NWA Vietnam's Electrical Service Trusted in the TodayTourist Choice as a companion on this journey.
In particular, I'd like to thank the HDV/MC Song team for their enthusiastic support, leading the professional program, bringing many laughter and meaningful experiences to the entire association.
